mapper.select: SELECT wc.id FROM work_cases wc WHERE wc.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND wc.ends_at <= #{checkoutMissingAt} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_records check_in WHERE check_in.work_case_id = wc.id AND check_in.attendance_type = 'CHECK_IN' AND check_in.result = 'SUCCESS' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_records check_out WHERE check_out.work_case_id = wc.id AND check_out.attendance_type = 'CHECK_OUT' AND check_out.result = 'SUCCESS' ) ORDER BY wc.ends_at, wc.id LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT wc.worker_id IS NOT NULL AS workerAssigned, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM work_invitations wi WHERE wi.work_case_id = wc.id AND wi.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND wi.accepted_by_user_id = wc.worker_id AND wi.expected_terms_version = wc.terms_version AND wi.accepted_terms_version = wc.terms_version AND wi.accepted_at IS NOT NULL ) AS invitationAccepted, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM work_contracts contract WHERE contract.work_case_id = wc.id AND contract.employer_id = wc.employer_id AND contract.worker_id = wc.worker_id AND contract.agreed_wage = wc.agreed_wage AND contract.source_terms_version = wc.terms_version ) AS contractMatched, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM escrows escrow WHERE escrow.work_case_id = wc.id AND escrow.amount = wc.agreed_wage AND escrow.status = 'HELD' ) AS escrowHeld, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM settlements settlement WHERE settlement.work_case_id = wc.id AND settlement.amount = wc.agreed_wage AND settlement.status = 'WAITING' AND settlement.due_at IS NULL ) AS settlementWaiting, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM workplaces workplace WHERE workplace.id = wc.workplace_id AND workplace.owner_user_id = wc.employer_id AND workplace.status = 'ACTIVE' AND workplace.latitude IS NOT NULL AND workplace.longitude IS NOT NULL ) AS workplaceLocated, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM documents document JOIN document_versions signed_version ON signed_version.document_id = document.id AND signed_version.version_type = 'SIGNED' JOIN document_signatures signature ON signature.document_id = document.id AND signature.signed_version_id = signed_version.id AND signature.signer_user_id = wc.worker_id AND signature.signed_checksum = signed_version.checksum JOIN document_versions original_version ON original_version.document_id = document.id AND original_version.id = signature.source_version_id AND original_version.version_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND signature.source_checksum = original_version.checksum JOIN document_shares share ON share.document_id = document.id AND share.work_case_id = wc.id AND share.shared_with_user_id = wc.worker_id AND share.purpose = 'CONTRACT_PARTY' AND share.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE document.work_case_id = wc.id AND document.document_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT' AND document.status = 'ACTIVE' AND signed_version.version_no = ( SELECT MAX(latest_version.version_no) FROM document_versions latest_version WHERE latest_version.document_id = document.id ) ) AS signedContractRecorded FROM work_cases wc WHERE wc.id = #{workCaseId}
